transcript.content: Cluster 161's top up-regulated markers are: si:ch211-56a11.2, prdx1, egr4, mt2, penka, slc1a2b, ndufa4l2a, scgn. Using ZFIN curated expression, ZFA anatomy, and GO, identify the most likely zebrafish cell type (with state if the markers support it), grounding each claim in a cited record. If the evidence is ambiguous, say so.

**Most likely: neural/neuronal cluster, probably peptidergic glutamate-handling neuron; state not resolved.**

## Evidence
- **penka** — proenkephalin neuropeptide precursor; expressed in CNS/neural tube/neurons/retina; GO supports neuropeptide signaling. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030729-31) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030729-31?utm_source=openai))
- **slc1a2b** — EAAT2/SLC1A2 paralog; expressed in nervous system and spinal cord neural tube; GO supports L-glutamate transmembrane transporter activity, consistent with glutamate handling. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-7779) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-7779?utm_source=openai))
- **scgn** — secretagogin calcium-binding protein; expressed in brain and spinal cord; GO calcium-ion binding supports excitable/secretory neuronal biology but is not cell-type-specific. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041010-82) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041010-82?utm_source=openai))
- **prdx1** — antioxidant/peroxiredoxin marker; expressed in diencephalon among several tissues, suggesting stress/redox tone but not defining lineage. [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050320-35) ([zfin.org](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050320-35?utm_source=openai))
- **nervous system** — ZFA/UBERON cross-reference defines it as predominantly neurons and glia, matching the shared ZFIN expression context. [record](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon/entities/http%253A%252F%252Fpurl.obolibrary.org%252Fobo%252FUBERON_0001016) ([ebi.ac.uk](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/ols4/ontologies/uberon/entities/http%253A%252F%252Fpurl.obolibrary.org%252Fobo%252FUBERON_0001016?utm_source=openai))

## Caveats
- **slc1a2b** can suggest glial glutamate uptake, but **penka** and **scgn** argue neuronal/secretory; astrocyte identity is not defensible from these markers alone.
- No provided canonical subtype marker cleanly fixes neurotransmitter class.

**Verdict:** peptidergic neural/neuronal cell — confidence medium**

**Most defensible: CNS neuropeptidergic neuron, likely forebrain/diencephalic; glial or endocrine-pancreas alternatives remain weaker.**

## Evidence
- **penka** — strongest cell-type clue: proenkephalin, expressed in CNS/neural tube/neurons/retina; predicted in neuropeptide signaling and chemical synaptic transmission [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030729-31); GO neuropeptide signaling supports neuronal secretory identity [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:0007218).
- **dlx5a** — forebrain/diencephalon/telencephalon expression supports an anterior-CNS neuronal hypothesis, not pancreas [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-990415-49); diencephalon is a forebrain neuromere including thalamus/hypothalamus/habenula/epiphysis [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0000101).
- **egr4** — expressed in brain and predicted transcription-regulatory activity, consistent with neuronal/CNS identity but not subtype-specific [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-080204-90).
- **scgn** — ambiguous: expressed in brain/spinal cord **and** pancreas/pancreatic bud; supports either neuroendocrine/neuronal or endocrine-pancreas alternatives [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-041010-82). Endocrine pancreas is islet-cell tissue producing insulin/glucagon/somatostatin [record](https://zfin.org/ZFA:0001260).
- **slc1a2b** — alternative glial-like hypothesis: expressed in nervous system/spinal cord neural tube and predicted L-glutamate transporter activity [record](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-030131-7779); GO defines L-glutamate transporter activity as membrane transfer of glutamate [record](https://amigo.geneontology.org/amigo/term/GO:0005313).
- **prdx1 / mt2** — stress/metal-redox genes; they argue for stress state overlay, not a lineage call [prdx1](https://zfin.org/ZDB-GENE-050320-35/expression).

## Caveats
- Deepest defensible tier: **CNS neuron**, probably neuropeptidergic/forebrain; exact neuronal subtype is not defensible from these markers alone.
- **Endocrine pancreas** is a real alternative via scgn, but penka+dlx5a+egr4+slc1a2b weigh more strongly toward CNS.

**Verdict:** CNS neuropeptidergic neuron, mature/stress — confidence medium
